// diagnostic

E3215

`#FFI(<lang>)` inline foreign fn in an unsafe language (`c`/`cpp`/`asm`) lacks the enclosing `#Unsafe("reason")` gate (D-FFI-INLINE1/ASM1/CPP1)

What

`#FFI(<lang>)` inline foreign fn in an unsafe language (`c`/`cpp`/`asm`) lacks the enclosing `#Unsafe("reason")` gate (D-FFI-INLINE1/ASM1/CPP1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Wrap inline foreign code in an enclosing `#Unsafe("reason")` gate.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3215: tests/ui/ffi_asm_no_unsafe_gate.stderr.

Error [E3215]: `#FFI(asm)` needs an `#Unsafe("reason")` gate
  --> tests/ui/ffi_asm_no_unsafe_gate.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | #FFI(asm)
    | ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `asm` is an unsafe foreign language — an inline `asm` body can break memory safety, so Jet requires you to state why it is sound to call (I1/S58)
 Fix: Add the gate: `#Unsafe("…") #FFI(asm) fn …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3215
